summary: Multi-page, cute and aesthetic Valentine’s Day proposal website with interactive elements, responsive design, smooth transitions, photo memories, love note/letters, interactive Yes/No proposal flow, and a final page after tapping YES (celebration page removed); support editing key content directly on the page (no-backend).
architectural_notes: Implement as a multi-page (or routed) responsive website with smooth transitions between sections/pages.
Provide easily editable content via placeholders (e.g., [Name]) and centralized configuration for text/media.
Add a client-side on-page edit mode (no backend) to update personalization content at runtime; persist edits locally (e.g., localStorage) and/or allow export/import of the config JSON.
Remove optional background audio/music controls and any related UI/state.
Update routing so the YES action navigates directly to the final page; remove the celebration page/route and any related animations.

existing_features.title: Create a multi-page, mobile-first Valentine’s Day proposal website with these pages and routes: Landing, Photos & Memories, Love Note, Proposal Question, and Celebration; include smooth animated transitions between pages.

Implement a consistent visual theme across the site: soft pastel palette (baby pinks, whites, reds, light neutrals), cute/minimal/elegant typography, and romantic decorative motifs (hearts/flowers/sparkles) with subtle animations.

Build the Landing page with a romantic heading that uses a name placeholder (e.g., “Hey [Name]… I Have Something to Ask You 💖”), a cute background, an optional soft-music control (play/pause + mute), and a primary button labeled “Click to Continue” that navigates to the next page.
Add a Photos & Memories page that displays a set of photos in a cute collage layout with small captions under each photo, and includes an animated slideshow or gallery effect.

Add a Love Note page with a heartfelt message/letter area that can be easily edited (content stored in a single front-end configuration/module), using elegant fonts and an animated text-appearance effect.

Add an Interactive Proposal Question page that asks “Will You Be My Valentine?” and shows two buttons: “YES 💘” and “NO”. If “NO” is clicked, the NO button should playfully move around OR the page should show a funny “Try Again 😜” message; if “YES 💘” is clicked, navigate to the Celebration page.

Create a Celebration page with confetti/hearts animation and final romantic message text: “Yay! You just made me the happiest person 💕”, plus an optional section to display date plan details (editable in the same front-end configuration/module used for personalization).

Provide a site-wide personalization mechanism (e.g., a single exported config object) for: recipient name, headings, captions, love note text, and date plan details; ensure all user-facing text in the UI is in English.

Add “extra touches” across pages: smooth scrolling effects where relevant, cute animations (e.g., sparkles/hearts), and optional embedded cute GIF-style visuals using local static assets (no backend dependency).
Add generated static art assets to support the romantic theme and render them in the UI from the frontend public assets directory.
Add an on-page “Edit mode” UI that lets the site owner edit personalization content (recipient name, headings/subheadings, and button labels) directly in the browser without code changes.
Persist all edited content on the client (no backend) so changes remain after refresh and revisiting the site.
Extend the Love Note content model and UI to support multiple letters (not just a single letter), and allow creating/editing/removing letters in Edit mode.
Make the Photos & Memories section editable in Edit mode, including adding/removing photos and editing captions/memories.
Provide a safe way to set photo sources when adding/editing a photo memory item in Edit mode (e.g., by entering an image URL and/or selecting a local file) without requiring any backend storage.
Remove the background music section from the Landing page so no music controls are shown and no background audio element is mounted.
Update the proposal YES button flow to skip the current heart celebration page and navigate directly to the final page after the user taps YES.

new_feature_requests.summary: Landing page with romantic heading, soft pastel theme, and "Click to Continue" navigation
Photo & memory section with collage layout, captions, and animated slideshow/gallery effect
Message/Love note page with editable personalized letter, elegant fonts, and animated text appearance
Interactive proposal question page with YES/NO buttons; NO triggers playful movement or try-again message; YES routes to celebration
Site-wide styling: soft pastel palette, cute minimal aesthetic, romantic motifs (hearts/flowers/sparkles), smooth animations and page transitions, mobile-first responsiveness
Personalization placeholders (e.g., [Name]) and easily editable text/content throughout the site
On-page editing UI for personalization content (names, letters/love note text, photo captions/memories) without requiring code changes
Update proposal flow so tapping YES navigates directly to the final page (remove/skips the heart celebration page)

projectName: Multi-page cute Valentine’s Day proposal website with interactive Yes/No flow, photos, love note, music, and celebration
